comment: Context window size (tokens) per model id prefix; the longest matching prefix wins. Used only when the statusLine gives no context reading (spec 18.4). Sessions above this size are treated as 1M extended context. Fable 5.x, Sonnet 5+, Haiku 5.5 and Opus 4.7+ run with the 1M window by default; entries here stay in effect under your own (a prefix you set wins).
